plan_basis.batch: R0 read-only inventory + R1 same-input screening

chipmunk_arm: MISSING_ASSET: author block-mean proxy requires full-M (31668-row) group statistics, masks and valid 52-row tail; only 2048-row uniform panels exist for CAL sources. Not scored, no scattered-mean substitute; deferred to R2 shared capture.
nonlinear_state_arms: B_L/B_N (plan identities 3/4) NOT run this batch; only if state-information verification is needed.
supplementary_trigger: fires iff median over high 40 layers of (reuseY - Q1) CAL4 math-lift MSE <= 0 AND at least one high expensive site has FREE_RIDGE main DEV5 math-lift MSE below Q1 by more than epsilon_num; pre-registered, evaluated once, no post-hoc changes

ridge.normalization: source-equal-weight gated loss; Z = mean_c ||g*Y_c||^2/n_c + 1e-12; ridge = lambda/(||A_Q1||_F^2 + 1e-12); Gram M = sum_c X_c^T X_c/(S n_c Z)
ridge.solver: gate per-channel shared across CAL sources (R0-verified bitwise at 7 sites; re-asserted at runtime per expensive site); one shared-Gram eigh; column filter g_j^2/(g_j^2*mu + ridge); exact unique solution; F64 filter and normal-residual check
ridge.robust_role: diagnostic only; no lambda selection by pilot
ridge.export: A_free = BF16(A_Q1 + D_main); D_main saved BF16-raw-uint16; math lift uses unrounded FP32 sum

precision: TF32 off; native BF16 addmm/tanh-GELU boundaries; FP32 math lift; BF16 cache/gate replay (cache=BF16(y0-u0@a), base=BF16(u1@a+cache), gated=BF16(base*g), target=BF16(y1*g)); FP64 error reductions; small-M replay excludes full-M residual writeback (proxy boundary, not full-path equivalence)
readouts: source-equal-weight current-gate absolute SSE/MSE and paired change vs Q1, high/low separate; increment-target and full-Y normalization auxiliary; math lift and BF16 replay separate tables; ridge training numerical rank, normal relative residual, omega per DEV source; ICC zero-increment control; archive-vs-recomputed native rel_l2 and bit mismatch

r0_verification.sidecar_schema: file_sha256 present; sampled payload SHA matches sidecar
r0_verification.gate_identity: bitwise equal across all 9 sources at high/0,4,19,34 step1 and low/4,19,34 step3

limitations: CAL4 already used for the original Q1 fit; DEV5 are exposed development sources. Source-out readouts are development screening, NOT blind confirmation.

About 114-137 matched rows per source at high/4 (~500 CAL rows total) for a 5120x5120 D: severely underdetermined; ridge uniqueness is not identification. Training rank, normal residual and omega bound the claim.
Small-M paired-row math lift and BF16 cache/gate replay only; no full-M residual writeback, no free-trajectory or video evidence.
Chipmunk author arm not scored (full-M proxy groups missing); recorded MISSING_ASSET with required fields, deferred to R2.
ICC evaluated only at the frozen svd_r512 two-residual config on six sites; no rank reallocation, no full-40 resident-cache or video memory test.
Gate sharing across sources R0-verified at 7 sites and re-asserted at runtime per expensive site; job fails loudly if violated, no silent fallback.
All results including unfavorable configurations retained; no post-hoc site/lambda/threshold selection; supplementary site governed by the pre-registered trigger only.
